bio.text: Chris Getty is an independent candidate for Illinois' 4th Congressional District in 2026; he filed nominating petitions in May 2026.
He has been mayor of Lyons, Illinois, since 2009.
He was elected the youngest mayor in Illinois at age 26, and he also serves as Supervisor of the Township of Lyons.
